title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・揃って、何度でも

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Argh! What the crap! I couldn't beat you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Dammit, dammit, dammit! Hayahide, you're such a pain in the butt!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin, I…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're right! I most certainly am!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's no fair!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
They suddenly hear Winning Ticket yelling as they're on the way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No fair, no fair, no fair, no faaair! It's not cool how well you two are getting along!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I wanna race with you guys toooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, you've only got yourself to blame for getting injured.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now, now. No need to cry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The three of us are still in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Which means we can race against each other as often as we wish to.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! That is right!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooh, I know! Let's all race in the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It'll be a BNW reunion!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you seriously not embarrassed using that name?
The three of them vow to race together at the autumn Tenno Sho before parting ways.
